Material-led sustainability, engineered.text: DESIGN PHILOSOPHY Material-led sustainability, engineered for delight. Our process pairs editorial clarity with tactile experimentation—mockups, light studies, and iteration cycles that translate from concept to construction with minimal friction. 01 Sustainable We treat sustainability as a design constraint that improves the experience: balanced daylight, low-toxicity finishes, durable details, and envelope performance that supports comfort across seasons. Passive-first massing and operable shading tuned to climate data and occupancy patterns. Material passports for stone, timber, and metalwork to support circular procurement. Specification sets optimized for longevity: repairable assemblies and robust tolerances. Philosophy Highlights Biophilic principles Low-VOC interiors Daylight autonomy Thermal comfort modeling

A small team, built for precision..text: STUDIO A small team, built for precision. We combine architectural practice with product-like clarity—consistent deliverables, calm reviews, and deeply considered details. What we value We're a design studio that treats coordination as part of aesthetics. The best spaces are not only beautiful, they are buildable, legible, and maintainable. Craft over noise Elegant assemblies, clear interfaces, and materials that improve with age. Performance as comfort Daylight, acoustics, and thermal balance translated into everyday ease. Documentation as design Drawings that read well to builders and reduce rework on site. PROJECT HIGHLIGHT Urban Oasis Tower A vertical neighborhood with shaded terraces, high-performance glazing, and communal layers tuned for daily life. In Development Where skyline presence meets human-scale comfort. Urban Oasis Tower integrates a climate-aware façade with shared amenities: shaded garden decks, a community lounge, and a flexible co-working level. Structure and envelope are coordinated to keep services efficient and interiors quiet. Façade strategy Deep vertical fins + operable shading tuned to orientation. Public layers Garden terraces every 6 floors, connected by a social stair. Performance Target: 28% operational energy reduction vs typical baseline. Discuss this project View comparable towers Communal lounge Warm timber + acoustic ceiling Garden terraces Native planting + shaded seating Facade rhythm Vertical fins + bronze accents Service clarity Stacked cores, efficient risers SERVICES A clear path from concept to site. Choose targeted consultation or a full-service engagement. Expand each phase to see what's included and how decisions are documented. PHASE CONSULTATION FULL SERVICE 01 Discovery & Brief Feasibility pack Stakeholder workshops What you get Site reading, program alignment, adjacency diagrams, and a short decision memo outlining budget levers, schedule risks, and permitting implications. How we document A concise feasibility PDF with annotated plans, precedent references, and a “decision ladder” that maps options to cost and performance. 02 Design & Modeling Massing + daylight 3D coordination model What you get Iterative concept sets, façade and interior direction, and performance studies (daylight, glare, ventilation) aligned to your goals. How we document Option boards and model snapshots that keep conversations focused—what changes, why it matters, and what it costs. 03 Planning & Approvals Advisory reviews Planning submission What you get Planning sets with narrative support, stakeholder coordination, and quick-turn responses to review comments. How we document A submission book that pairs drawings with intent notes, making approvals smoother for reviewers and consultants. 04 Construction & Supervision Detail advisory Site administration What you get Tender support, shop drawing review, site visits, and punch list coordination to protect design intent through delivery. How we document Issue tracking, photo logs, and decision records to minimize ambiguity and maintain momentum on site.
